page.overview:
Who is Bill Tanner?

Bill Tanner is the Chief of Staff of the Secret Intelligence Service (SIS/MI6), and one of James Bond's friends in the service. Based on Ian Fleming's literary character, he serves as a recurring ally in Dynamite Entertainment's James Bond comic series.
